entities.name: Pratap Singh I of Idar

entities.summary: Colonel His Highness Maharajadhiraja Sir Pratap Singh I,, was a Maharaja of the Kingdom of Idar, administrator and Regent of the Kingdom of Marwar and heir to Ahmednagar later renamed as Himmatnagar from 1902 to 1911.
